description: Level-3 MOM SegmentResponse (ISA-95 Part 4 / B2MML OperationsResponse.SegmentResponse) = the actuals per manufacturing stage. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/segment-response.md, description.

attributes.name: segment_response_no
attributes.description: Identity of the SegmentResponse (join key). Recommendation: <production_order_no>.<sequence>.

attributes.name: operations_response_ref
attributes.description: FK to OperationsResponse.production_order_no (PART_OF). The order actuals to which these segment actuals belong.

attributes.name: segment_requirement_ref
attributes.description: FK to SegmentRequirement.segment_requirement_no (RESPONDS_TO). The target segment whose actuals are reported here.

attributes.name: process_segment_ref
attributes.description: FK to ProcessSegment.process_segment_no (FOR_PROCESS_SEGMENT). Which manufacturing stage was executed.

attributes.name: sequence
attributes.description: Sequence of this segment within the order.

attributes.name: material_lot_ref
attributes.description: FK to MaterialLot.material_lot_no (ACTUAL_MATERIAL) = MaterialActual.MaterialLotID. The material lot actually consumed/produced; role via material_use.

attributes.name: material_use
attributes.description: ISA-95 MaterialActual.MaterialUse — the ROLE of the material (actual). Mirrors the SegmentRequirement role.

attributes.name: qty_actual
attributes.description: Actual quantity of this material role (actual). Counterpart to SegmentRequirement.qty_planned.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure of qty_actual.

attributes.name: equipment_ref
attributes.description: FK to Machine.machine_id (ACTUAL_EQUIPMENT; Machine ≡ EquipmentUnit level) = EquipmentActual.EquipmentID. The equipment actually used.

attributes.name: actual_start_time
attributes.description: Actual stage start (actual).

attributes.name: actual_end_time
attributes.description: Actual stage end (actual).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Actual status of the stage (e.g. running, complete, aborted). Derived from the MES OrderState.

attributes.name: qty_good
attributes.description: Good parts counted at the machine for the running order. Reported by the machine source through objects[] (owner 25.09.); history: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/segment-response.md.

attributes.name: qty_scrap
attributes.description: Scrap parts counted at the machine for the running order. Reported by the machine source through objects[] (owner 25.09.); history: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/segment-response.md.

attributes.name: qty_total
attributes.description: All parts (good + scrap) counted at the machine for the running order. Reported by the machine source through objects[] (owner 25.09.); history: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/segment-response.md.

attributes.name: program_ref
attributes.description: The NC or machine program the machine reports as active. Reported by the machine source through objects[] (owner 25.09.); history: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/segment-response.md.

attributes.name: tool_ref
attributes.description: The tool or mould the machine reports as set up for the order. Reported by the machine source through objects[] (owner 25.09.); history: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/segment-response.md.

attributes.name: qty_rework
attributes.description: Parts sent to rework, counted at the machine for the running order. Reported by the machine source through objects[] (owner 25.09.); history: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/segment-response.md.

attributes.name: production_order_ref
attributes.description: The production order the machine reports it is running. Reported by the machine source through objects[] (owner 25.09.); history: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/segment-response.md.

attributes.name: article_ref
attributes.description: The article the machine reports it is producing. Reported by the machine source through objects[] (owner 25.09.); history: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/segment-response.md.

attributes.name: program_line
attributes.description: The active line of the running program. Reported by the machine source through objects[] (owner 25.09.); history: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/segment-response.md.

attributes.name: program_status
attributes.description: The state of the running program (running, stopped, …). Reported by the machine source through objects[] (owner 25.09.); history: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/segment-response.md.

relationships.description: The order actuals that contain these segment actuals.
The executed manufacturing stage (= plant = Function).
The material lot consumed/produced; role via material_use.
The equipment actually used (Machine ≡ EquipmentUnit level, consolidation 2026-07-15 — the source fkColumn carries machine ids).

isa95.note: ISA-95 Part 4 OperationsResponse.SegmentResponse = actuals per ProcessSegment, with MaterialActual (MaterialUse=role, MaterialLot) + EquipmentActual. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/operations/segment-response.md, isa95 › note.
